verified: Xpeng's Q3 2026 results, as reported by electrive, show revenue of about €3.1 billion (RMB 24.28 billion), up 19.1% year on year, with the company still posting a loss; cnevpost reports the figure came in above the top of Xpeng's own guidance, on 118,390 deliveries.
unconfirmed: how much of the growth came from the Volkswagen technology partnership — the source says only that it "once again contributed", with no figure — and the details of the Q4 delivery guidance of 169,000–174,000 units, the 13.1% vehicle margin, a net loss that widened 127.9% year on year while narrowing 35.1% quarter on quarter, and a plan to at least double overseas sales in 2027, all of which rest on secondary reports of the earnings call rather than the source.

verified: 据 electrive 报道，小鹏 2026 年第三季度营收约 31 亿欧元，同比增长 19.1%；财报数据（RMB 24.28 亿元口径为 242.8 亿元人民币，约合该欧元金额）显示其超过公司自身指引上限，且与大众汽车的技术合作再次贡献增长；公司当期仍处于亏损状态（来源：electrive 报道及 cnevpost、Yahoo Finance 对财报的引述）。
unconfirmed: 净亏损的具体走向存在口径差异——cnevpost 称净亏损环比收窄 35.1%、但同比扩大 127.9%，electrive 原文仅称“继续亏损”而未给数字；车辆毛利率回升至 13.1%、第四季度 16.9 万至 17.4 万辆交付指引以及 2027 年海外销量至少翻倍，均为公司财报电话会上的说法或预测，尚无独立验证，且 electrive 原文未提及这些细节。

titles.en: Xpeng Q3 2026 revenue rises 19.1% to about €3.1 billion
titles.zh: 小鹏汽车2026年Q3营收约31亿欧元，同比增长19.1%
